toolsPanel.title: Tools panel
toolsPanel.text: The panel contains all available image editing tools. Individual tools allow various modifications of the image and may provide additional settings and configuration options.

topPanelLeft.title: File Management
topPanelLeft.text: This section provides controls for managing the current file, including displaying and editing the file name, opening a new file, or closing the current one.

topPanelCenter.title: Editing Controls
topPanelCenter.text: The central panel contains controls for basic editing actions such as undo and redo, and zoom controls for adjusting the image view.

topPanelRight.title: Help and Settings
topPanelRight.text: This area provides access to the help section and configuration settings of the editor.

viewport.title: Viewport
viewport.text: The viewport represents the main editing area where the image is displayed and edited. It allows interaction with the image using the available tools.

toolSettings.title: Tool Settings
toolSettings.text: This section displays configuration options for the currently selected tool, allowing adjustment of parameters specific to the selected editing operation.

exportTool.title: Export Tool
exportTool.text: The export tool provides options for saving the edited image in various output formats. Export parameters such as file format or quality can be configured before generating the final file.

dragDropArea.title: Drag and Drop Area
dragDropArea.text: This area allows opening an image file by dragging and dropping it into the editor, providing a quick way to load an image without using the file menu.
